name: Uniform Point Cloud Voxelization and Simplification
definition: A preprocessing technique to simplify large point clouds by voxelizing them and randomly sampling points within voxels to a target density, followed by re-projecting the simplified points onto multi-planes for aggregation weight calculation.
summary: Uniform Point Cloud Voxelization and Simplification probabilistically downsamples large point clouds by voxel density to a target count, then projects them onto multi-planes for neural rendering aggregation.
